targets.query:
from(bucket: "localdatadb2")
  |> range(start: 2015-01-01)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "solarpanel")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "power today" or r["_field"] == "power month")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1mo, fn: sum)
  |> group()
  |> cumulativeSum()

from(bucket: "localdatadb2")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "solarpanel")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "power today")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["location"] == "Delfgauw")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "last")

import "date"
from(bucket: "localdatadb2")
  |> range(start: date.truncate(t: now(), unit: 1y))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "solarpanel")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "power today")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["location"] == "Delfgauw")
  |> max()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> yield(name: "max_value_with_date")
